item.title: What the h_ll is a PLL? Digging in to the Doepfer A-196
item.description: video upload by Sound + Voltage "This time we're diving deep - perhaps too deep - into the mysteries of the Phase-Locked Loop, which Doepfer improbably made a Eurorack module for. So if you want to learn what that loop is and why you'd want to lock it, this is for you. All four of you. No AI content, though I do use it for research. item.title: Sampler-Synth M5STACK TAB5 (ESP32-P4) demo sound
item.description: video upload by zcarlos zc "ESP32-P4 DRUM MACHINE V-SAMPLER / SYNTH Sound demo of my DIY drum machine based on samples and a synth engine. 'This is not a jam' :) Hardware: M5STACK TAB5 Shopping link: https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_EvUGwd2 Synth engine: Wavetable engine. Sampler: WAV files on SD card 44100Hz, 16 Bit, Mono 16 sound polyphony. A track can be sampler or synth Multi OSC feature.

item.title: Digitakt II: Synthesis and Noise Only
item.description: video upload by EZBOT "Can you make a decent sounding pattern on the Digitakt II with only Oscillators and Noise only? In this video, we dive deep into the factory utilities on the Elektron Digitakt 2 to see just how far the internal engine can be pushed. All sounds (drums, chords, leads etc.) will be made using fun and clever sampler techniques." EZBOT resources: https://www.patreon.com/ezbot,

item.description: video upload by DMT Audio "Out now for Cherry Audio’s Voltage Modular Software - the WC-46 Sequential Voltage Source.
